text: Upon observation or from afar, they all seem to have a pretty similar pattern I would say. There's nothing that really stems out at the moment, let's see, yeah they're all pretty similar in spread, the amount of outliers, whether they have either zero or they all have three up to three from what I'm seeing. I would say however 13 it's a little bit odd when you see the other ones just because the extreme values noted on blue are extremely close as opposed to the other ones where they look pretty uniformly spread. Same with the red part of 13, their extreme values are extremely far apart from each other that doesn't compare to any other ones in the map.
